end.summary:
Reviewed levels of organisation: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.
Yash gave examples such as muscle cells, muscle tissue, heart, and circulatory system.
Yash ordered cell → tissue → organ → organ system; organism was not completed in the final response.
The heart-versus-circulatory-system mix-up was corrected during the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation using a ladder and examples from the human body. Yash explained that cells form tissues, tissues form organs, and organs work together in organ systems. They briefly mixed up the heart and circulatory system, then corrected this by identifying the heart as one organ and the circulatory system as including the heart, blood, and veins. At home, ask Yash to make one complete ladder ending with “organism” and add one human and one plant example at each level.
